summary: The grid model, built from the design records capture run 43316397906 recorded: - sdk/policy/placement.py: ShipLayout parses hull masks (Rows x Columns digits,   row-major; 1 buildable, 0 outside, 2 unconfirmed so refused), room footprints,   prices, minimum ship levels, root designs and purchase limits (the stricter   reading; mixed availability masks refused); - placement_refusal refuses on any unobserved input, a cell off the grid or not   buildable, an overlap, a price other than minerals or gas, too low a ship level,   or a full purchase limit; first_free scans from the top-left; - snapshots gain Room.row/column and ship_design_id. They are left out of equality,   and the baseline format is unchanged, so existing baselines still load equal. Tests use pss5's real hull and room layout: the Gas Collector Lv1 first fits at row 1, column 1. Every policy plans identically for every bundled scenario with or without room positions (S13-R9).
